title: The release's report fields survive a parse (rollback point reads what the release writes – R-regression-9, E1)
A converted letter template keeps its logo (B0-14, B3-9)

The records-reviewed list names an imported note by its own heading: a note headed 'Review' (stored as a follow-up) is listed as 'Review', a 'Type: Re-assessment' line as 'Re-assessment' – never as 'Follow-up' (R1T-WF-L1)
